q: How many integers n with 1 <= n <= 1000 are divisible by 3 or by 5, but not by both?
What is the sum of the decimal digits of 2^50?
What is the remainder when 7^2026 is divided by 13?
In how many ways can a 2 x 10 rectangle be tiled completely with 1 x 2 dominoes (dominoes may be placed horizontally or vertically)?
Two fair six-sided dice are rolled. What is the probability that the sum is a prime number? Give the answer as a reduced fraction.
How many trailing zeros does 125! (125 factorial) have?
What is the smallest positive integer that leaves remainder 2 when divided by 3, remainder 3 when divided by 5, and remainder 2 when divided by 7?
A fair six-sided die is rolled repeatedly until every face has appeared at least once. What is the expected number of rolls? Give the exact answer as a reduced fraction.
How many lattice paths go from (0,0) to (6,6) using unit steps right (+1,0) or up (0,+1) and never go strictly above the line y = x?
Compute the determinant of the 3x3 matrix with rows [2, 1, -3], [1, 3, -1], [0, 5, 4].
How many 4-digit positive integers have digits that are strictly increasing from left to right (for example 1359)?
Alice is twice as old as Bob was when Alice was as old as Bob is now. The sum of their current ages is 63. What are their current ages? Answer as Alice,Bob (for example 40,23).
Compute the sum of floor(sqrt(k)) for k = 1, 2, ..., 100.
How many subsets of {1, 2, ..., 10} (including the empty set) have an element sum divisible by 5?

Five people A, B, C, D, E sit in a row of seats numbered 1 to 5 from left to right. A sits immediately to the left of B (A is in the seat just before B). E is not in seat 1 or seat 5. C is not next to A. D sits somewhere to the right of B. C sits somewhere to the left of E. D is not next to E. Give the seating from seat 1 to seat 5 as a 5-letter string (for example ABCDE).

Two towns are 300 miles apart on a straight track. Train A leaves the first town at 9:00 heading toward the second at a constant 60 mph. Train B leaves the second town at 9:30 heading toward the first at a constant 90 mph. At what clock time do they meet? Answer as H:MM (for example 10:45).
How many palindromic positive integers less than or equal to 10000 are divisible by 11?
